subject: [PATCH v5 06/22] xfs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch converts the XFS iomap operations to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using macros that wrap the iomap_iter_next() helper. This change does not introduce any functional changes and is a conversion effort. The patch updates several functions in xfs_iomap.c and xfs_file.c to use the new callback. It also adds new functions for each of the existing iomap operations, which are defined using the DEFINE_IOMAP_ITER_NEXT() macro. The reviewed-by tags indicate that Christoph Hellwig and Darrick J. Wong have reviewed this patch.
